Risk description: Ransomware via unpatched edge VPN appliance
Treatment actions (controls): Patch within 7 days; MFA on VPN; EDR on servers; immutable backups

Risk description: Business email compromise of finance staff
Treatment actions (controls): Payment call-back procedure; DMARC p=reject; targeted awareness

Risk description: Sensitive data pasted into public generative-AI tools
Treatment actions (controls): Approved AI platform; AI acceptable-use policy; DLP rules; impact assessment

Risk description: Single logistics SaaS provider with no exit plan
Treatment actions (controls): Contract exit clause; quarterly data export test; secondary provider identified

Risk description: AI pricing model drifts and produces discriminatory quotes
Treatment actions (controls): Bias testing before release; monthly drift monitoring; human review threshold
